name: lizo-skills
description: Liz Osborn's Claude Code skills — onboarding psychology, agent architecture, and related design disciplines.

plugins.name: onboarding-psychologist
plugins.description: Designs first-time-user flows using the IDENTITY-TO-HABIT arc — grounded in BJ Fogg's Tiny Habits and Fogg Behavior Model, Nir Eyal's Hook Model, and James Clear's identity-based habits.

plugins.name: ai-agents-architect
plugins.description: Decision framework for agent architecture — single vs multi-agent, ReAct vs Plan-and-Execute vs Tree-of-Thoughts, autonomy spectrum, when to introduce an orchestrator.

plugins.name: make-skills-discipline
plugins.description: DEPRECATED 2026-06-14 — use loom-discipline instead. This plugin was a subset of loom-discipline; consolidated to honor the one-canonical-home rule (tapestry/MANIFESTO.md Pillar 1). Existing installs continue to work; new installs should use loom-discipline@lizo-skills. Slated for removal in a future marketplace release.
plugins.deprecation_notice: Use loom-discipline@lizo-skills — same functionality plus the v0.1.7-v0.1.13 features (auto-recall, MCP-registered loom-memory, Stop-hook upskilling check, Phase 2 local observer, LOOM_PROJECT_ID scope gate).

plugins.name: loom-discipline
plugins.description: Canonical Claude Code discipline plugin (consolidates the deprecated make-skills-discipline). Auto-injects PROBE-first behavior, file:line citation enforcement, dev-tooling-vs-runtime distinction, friction-as-memory writing. Includes auto-recall on SessionStart, MCP-registers loom-memory at https://loom-agent-context.onrender.com/mcp/memory/, Stop-hook upskilling check (CORE DIRECTIVE 2), Phase 2 local observer (Path A candidates to architecture-registry), and per-project scope gate via LOOM_PROJECT_ID. Emits OTLP events to Grafana Cloud LGTM.

plugins.name: liz-patterns
plugins.description: Liz Osborn's canonical patterns library — ONE home for her reusable agents, skills, and tools. Available in every Claude Code session in every project, so the same pattern means the same thing wherever invoked. Replaces the duplicated copies that previously lived in docs-agent/skills/, Make_Skills/skills/, Make_Skills/skills_private/, the-loom/skills/, and the-loom/skills_private/. Compiled by the recursive-skill-engine loop (see Tapestry MANIFESTO Part 3 Pillar 1).
